verses.1: And moreover, God punished the former people with water because of the sins of the children of Cain; He drowned the earth with water and cleansed it from all defilement, because of the transgression of the children of Cain.
verses.2: And He destroyed all the workers of iniquity, for He said, 'I have repented of what I did for the children of men'; and He destroyed them all, and nothing remained except
verses.3: Noah, who kept the covenant of God, so that the earth might not again be destroyed by water, and the children of Noah, so that they might not eat of death and corruption, and so that they might not worship foreign gods besides God their Creator, and that He might be their God, and that He might not destroy them with a flood in vain, and that He might not withhold from them the rain of spring and autumn, and that He might give them increase in their labor, for men and for beasts, fruit and grass and plants, and that they might direct their ways in all that God desires.
verses.4: And after this ordinance He gave them, the children of Israel forsook God in their wickedness, and did not walk as their fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, who did not transgress the commandment of God their Creator.
verses.5: But as for these children of Israel, they were rebellious in their deeds, from their youth until their old age, they who did not keep the commandment of God.
verses.6: Even their Levites, and the angels, and all their scribes transgressed the commandment of God.
verses.7: And they did not stand in the law and in the ordinance of God which Moses commanded them in the book of the law, saying, 'Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.'
verses.8: And love your neighbor as yourself, and do not worship foreign gods, and do not commit adultery with another man's wife, and do not kill a soul, and do not steal.
verses.9: And do not bear false witness, and do not covet the property of your neighbor, nor anything that belongs to your brother, whether his ox or his donkey.
verses.10: And when He commanded the children of Israel these things, the rebellious ones turned aside to wickedness and injustice, and violence and oppression, and adultery with another's wife, and theft, and falsehood, and the worship of idols.
verses.11: And at Horeb also the children of Israel forsook God, making a calf of molten metal, and they worshipped it and said, 'These are our gods who brought us out of the land of Egypt.'
verses.12: And they rejoiced in the work of their hands, and they ate and drank and were satisfied, and they rose up to play.
verses.13: And because of this Moses was zealous, and he came down from Mount Sinai, for God said to him, 'Your people have corrupted themselves and sinned, whom you brought out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and they have made for themselves a calf and worshipped it.'
verses.14: And Moses came down with Joshua his servant, while he was zealous for the people; and when Joshua heard, he said, 'Behold, I hear the sound of war in the camp of Israel.'
verses.15: And Moses said to Joshua, 'It is not the sound of the cry of war, but the sound of those who are drunk with wine.' And he went down and drew near to them, and he ground it to powder in his hand until it became like dust, and he scattered it upon the water from which the children of Israel drank, at the foot of the mountain.
verses.16: And then he commanded the Levites to kill among themselves, because of the evil they had done before God.
verses.17: And they did as he commanded them, their leaders, that the wrath of God might be great, by the killing of their own selves, and by the killing of their relatives and their fathers.
verses.18: And because of this Moses said to them, 'Consecrate yourselves to the Lord, who has saved you and delivered you and brought you out of the house of bondage, and has given you as an inheritance the inheritance which He swore to your fathers, to give to them and to their seed after them.'
verses.19: And there they did not forsake the worship of God, for in all evil and wickedness they walked.
verses.20: And it was not like their fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, who served God in the uprightness of their ways, from their youth until the days of their old age and their death, that He might give them what is on earth and what is in heaven, which He has prepared for those who love Him: on this earth an inheritance flowing with milk and honey, and there the paradise of joy which is prepared for the righteous, which eye has not seen, nor ear heard, nor has it entered into the heart of man, which God has prepared for those who love Him—for Abraham and for Isaac and for Jacob, who served God in their lives.
verses.21: But their children, these very ones, were apostates and evildoers, who walked in the stubbornness of their heart, and did not listen to the word of God, who had saved them and delivered them and kept them from their youth.
verses.22: And they did not remember God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and delivered them from harsh slavery and from bitter bondage.
verses.23: But as for these, they forsook Him exceedingly; and He raises up for them those who surround them as strangers, and they rise up against them and do to them according to their will.
